gr_list.description: KnowledgeSearchClient — HTTP client for Knowledge search API in Automation service
ChunkSummarizer — Claude API call to summarize PDF chunk content for customer-friendly auto-reply
AiFaqHandler upgrade — replace FaqMatcher with KnowledgeSearchClient + ChunkSummarizer
DI registration updates in Automation Program.cs
Frontend — AiFaqData type + AiFaqNode + PropertyPanel (search_source toggle, updated description)
Contract schema + error codes + faq_entries→faqs migration SQL

plan.summary: Upgrade ai_faq FlowBuilder node from keyword-based FaqMatcher (reads faq_entries table directly) to Knowledge service semantic search (HTTP call to POST /search). When PDF chunk results match, Claude summarizes them before auto-sending to customer. min_confidence default changes from 0.3 to 0.65 for semantic scores. search_source toggle added (faq_only/all). FaqMatcher class deleted, faq_entries CRUD endpoints kept (separate concern).
plan.q_intent: ai_faq node'unu Knowledge servisi semantic search ile upgrade et. Mevcut keyword-based FaqMatcher yerine KnowledgeHttpClient kullanacak. Chunk sonuclari Claude ile ozetlenip gonderilecek. faq_entries → faqs migration. top_k sabit 3.
plan.interview_notes: Q decisions: (1) Chunk UX = Claude ile ozetlenip gonderilir, (2) Data = faq_entries→faqs SQL migration + FaqMatcher kaldirilir, (3) top_k = sabit 3, UI'da gostermiyoruz. Automation FAQ CRUD endpoints (/api/v1/faq/) korunacak — ayri concern.

verification_questions.question: When Knowledge service is down (timeout/connection error), does the ai_faq node gracefully route to no_match handle instead of throwing an exception or hanging the flow?
Does the upgraded handler correctly preserve __last_input reuse from preceding nodes (ai_intent→ai_faq chain) without forcing user to send message twice?
When ChunkSummarizer fails (Claude API error/timeout), does the handler fall back to raw chunk content or route to no_match, rather than silently swallowing the error?
Does the simulation path (MockFaqMatcher) remain untouched and continue working correctly without calling Knowledge service or Claude API?
Are faq_answer, faq_confidence, and faq_question variables always set (even on no_match) to prevent downstream {{variable}} template failures?

forbidden_areas: src/Invekto.Knowledge/ — Knowledge service code untouched, we only call its API
src/Invekto.Automation/Data/AutomationRepository.cs faq_entries methods — CRUD endpoints still use these
non_goals: Removing Automation FAQ CRUD endpoints (/api/v1/faq/) — separate concern
Modifying Knowledge service search logic — we consume as-is
Adding top_k to property panel UI — Q chose fixed default
Changing MockFaqMatcher behavior — simulation remains keyword-based
intentional_exclusions: faq_entries table DROP — table stays for existing CRUD endpoints
AutomationRepository FAQ methods — kept for /api/v1/faq/ endpoints
Knowledge service changes — zero modifications to Knowledge codebase

try_catch_locations: ChunkSummarizer.SummarizeAsync — try/catch returns null on failure
AiFaqHandler.MatchAndRoute — checks KnowledgeSearchResult.Available, ChunkSummarizer null result
user_facing_errors: No user-facing error messages — all failures route to no_match handle silently
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All failure paths log via JsonLinesLogger with error codes (INV-AT-042, INV-AT-043) before routing to no_match. No silent swallowing.

aha_moments.user_pain: FAQ keyword match is brittle — 'iademi' doesn't match 'iade', Turkish morphology ignored
aha_moments.suggestion: Semantic vector search understands meaning, not just exact keywords. 'iade istiyorum' and 'urunu geri gondermek istiyorum' both match return policy FAQ
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant sees that chatbot correctly answers customer questions it previously missed, without adding more keywords manually

aha_moments.user_pain: Flow builder FAQ node only searches FAQ entries — PDF documents uploaded to Knowledge are invisible to chatbot flows
aha_moments.suggestion: search_source='all' mode includes PDF chunk results, Claude-summarized into customer-friendly answers
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant uploads product manual PDF, chatbot immediately answers product questions from it without manual FAQ entry creation

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant has to manually create FAQ entries one by one in Automation, separately from Knowledge page
aha_moments.suggestion: Single source of truth: Knowledge service's faqs table. Create FAQs in Knowledge page, flow engine finds them automatically via semantic search
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant creates FAQ in Knowledge page and chatbot starts answering it immediately — no flow editing needed

aha_moments.user_pain: When FAQ confidence threshold is wrong, hard to debug why chatbot isn't matching — keyword scoring is opaque
aha_moments.suggestion: faq_source variable ('faq' or 'chunk') lets subsequent nodes act differently based on source type. Execution logs show Knowledge search method (semantic/keyword) and score
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support agent checks flow log, sees search method + score + source, immediately understands why match did/didn't happen

aha_moments.user_pain: Chatbot can't leverage rich PDF content (catalogs, manuals, policies) that tenants already uploaded
aha_moments.suggestion: Claude-summarized chunk answers turn static documents into interactive Q&A — customer asks about product, bot synthesizes answer from catalog PDF
aha_moments.aha_moment: Customer asks 'bu urunun ozellikleri neler?' and bot answers from product catalog PDF — tenant realizes their documents are 'alive' in the chatbot
